text:
Maya: Quick datapoint from last night's batch-formation profiler on the h100 fleet — when max_tokens_per_batch > 64 we see p99 latency jump ~2.3x. Root cause signal looks like kernel fallback tied to KV cache fragmentation.

Sasha: Can you paste the profiler summary / top traces? :thinking:

Maya: Short dump attached inline. Toplines: kernel_selector chose slower "occlusion" path when avg_kv_fragments_per_gpu > 12 and when mixed small/large KV lengths interleaved. Also saw queue_coalesce rate drop.

```
# profiler summary
pool: h100-canary
window: 00:00-03:00
max_tokens_per_batch: 128
p50: 14ms
p95: 42ms
p99: 210ms (baseline ~92ms)
kernel_fallback_rate: 0.18 -> 0.67 when avg_kv_fragments > 12
avg_kv_fragments_per_batch: 3.6 -> 15.1 during spikes
queue_coalesce_ratio: 0.72 -> 0.31
```

Ron: That matches the KV-frag hypothesis. If many requests have different prefix lengths the runtime can't pack them into the fast kernel shapes, ends up selecting a more generic kernel.

Liam: Two knobs we should try in parallel: (1) reduce batch_window_ms (faster pacing) to improve local homogeneity, (2) lower per-gpu token_budget_target so batches don't cross the fragmentation threshold.

Sasha: Can you propose concrete targets? We need per-GPU numbers.

Maya: Proposal (initial sweep):
```
# scheduler tweak proposal
pacing:
  burst_window_ms: 12
  max_hold_ms: 40
per_gpu_token_budget_target:
  H100: 1600
  A100: 1200
  A10: 900
  L4: 600
  T4: 500
kernel_selector:
  prefer_shape_packing: true
  max_kv_fragments_for_fast_kernel: 10
```

Ron: I like this. Two comments: prefer_shape_packing might increase p50 jitter for tiny requests on L4/T4; we should gate that by device class. Also add a safety rollback rule: if p99 > baseline * 1.2 for 10m -> rollback.

infra-bot: deploybot: scheduler-config v2026.03.11-c1 rolled to canary pool h100-canary (3 hosts).

Sasha: Started A/B run vs control (old config). I'll collect p50/p95/p99, kernel_fallback_rate, queue_coalesce_ratio.

Maya: Early numbers after 30m: H100 p99 back to baseline (210ms -> 95ms), throughput -3% (tokens/s), kernel_fallback_rate down from 0.67 -> 0.09. A10 p50 improved ~8%. T4 unchanged. L4 slight p95 regression (~10%).

Liam: Expected tradeoff — the selector is packing more aggressively which helps big memory cards but may hurt tiny-kernel efficiency.

Sasha: Suggestion: enable prefer_shape_packing only for A10/A100/H100, keep L4/T4 on conservative mode. Update config and run 12h sweep.

Maya: +1. Also add metric 'kernel_fallback_rate' to the alerting dashboard and emit a trace tag when a request forces fallback path.

Ron: I'll add the rollout plan + rollback rule to the runbook. If p99 > baseline*1.2 for 10m or kernel_fallback_rate > 0.25 -> auto rollback.

Sasha: Created experiment ticket EXP-4021 and attached the raw profiler dumps.

Maya: Thanks — will follow up with full profiler traces and a breakdown by kv_length buckets.

Ron: Nice work. After sweep we should codify per-gpu defaults and add a short doc for oncall describing the kernel_fallback signal and mitigation steps. :thumbsup:

Sasha: Oncall note: keep an eye on small-size traffic (chatty users) — they drive fragmentation.

Maya: Agreed. I'll also add a short sampling hook to stash one-trace-per-minute for canary hosts so we can debug regressions quickly.
